dedupe_keys.name: anatel data dashboards mobile coverage municipal telecom profile emf exposure and licensed stations brazil

description: This Anatel page collects four public dashboards on telecommunications infrastructure in Brazilian municipalities. Contents: the Mobile Coverage panel (percentage coverage by federative unit, drilling down to municipalities and census sectors with or without coverage), Meu Município Anatel (a telecom profile of a city to compare with other municipalities, its state, region and the country), the Electromagnetic Field Exposure map (measurements around mobile base stations shown in hexagons for a chosen municipality) and the Licensed Stations query (mobile base stations licensed in the Mosaico system). Producer: Anatel, the national telecommunications regulator; the page was published on 25 August 2021 and modified on 30 August 2021. Coverage: Brazil, municipality and sector level. Access: the page links to interactive dashboards with no login, and no bulk file is offered here. Licence and cost: free to view; the record states CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the dashboards are views, so extraction of tables may need the separate Anatel open data portal, and the page's own date is 2021 so the underlying refresh cycle should be checked. Simulation uses: coverage by census sector and licensed station locations support network resilience, coverage-gap and exposure analysis of mobile sites in floods and other hazards. Related record: Anatel open data (data-anatel-open-data).
